tasks.subject: Switch render.yaml to external Postgres (drop managed DB)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** render.yaml no longer references expired managed PG.
**Files:** render.yaml
**Steps:** branch bugfix/dev-pg-neon off development; remove `databases:` block; replace `fromDatabase` POSTGRES_* entries with `sync: false` secrets; add `POSTGRES_SSL` value "true" literal (Neon TLS-only, same pattern as REDIS_TLS); update header comments.
**Acceptance Criteria:** yaml valid; reviewers APPROVE; PR to development.
**Verify:** code-reviewer + api-reviewer APPROVE; /commit
```json:metadata
{"files": ["render.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "git diff development -- render.yaml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["databases: block removed", "POSTGRES_* sync:false", "POSTGRES_SSL true literal"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Provision Neon free Postgres + collect connection values
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace expired Render free PG with Neon free tier.
**Files:** none (user dashboard action)
**Steps:** neon.tech → create project (AWS us-west-2) → paste back POSTGRES_HOST (direct endpoint, NOT -pooler) / PORT / USER / PASSWORD / DB.
**Acceptance Criteria:** all five values provided.
**Verify:** TLS connection test succeeds.
```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "psql TLS connect select 1", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Neon project exists", "5 connection values provided"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Merge PR, deploy, verify health, reseed, sync docs and memory
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Dev tier green end-to-end.
**Files:** docs/ROADMAP.md, memory project_dev_deploy_config_state.md
**Steps:** merge PR → deploy-dev.yml (migrate empty Neon DB → hook → smoke) → curl /health 200 → optional seed → docs-maintainer ROADMAP item 0 (expiry incident + Neon switch) → memory update.
**Acceptance Criteria:** deploy green incl. smoke; /health 200; docs+memory updated.
**Verify:** gh run watch + curl health.
```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/ROADMAP.md"], "verifyCommand": "curl -sS https://memoflow-dev-api.onrender.com/health", "acceptanceCriteria": ["deploy green", "/health 200", "ROADMAP + memory updated"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
